title: Notices about bookings
hint: Choose how you want to be told about each event.
event_appointment_requested: A booking that needs your approval
event_appointment_cancelled: A booking cancelled by the client
footnote: A dash means that notice is not sent that way. Your clients always receive their own emails.
device_server_off: Device notices are not available yet.
device_unsupported: This browser cannot show notices when Kurz is closed.
device_ios: On iPhone and iPad, add Kurz to your Home Screen first, then open it from there and turn this on.
device_denied: Notices are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser settings, then try again.
device_error: Could not change this device. Try again.
